name: ATM Deposit Request V 02
definition: The ATMDepositRequest message is sent by an ATM to an acquirer or its agent to request the approval of a deposit transaction at an ATM, before or after deposit media inside the ATM.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMDepositRequest.name: ATM Deposit Request
ATMDepositRequest.definition: Information related to the request of a deposit transaction from an ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
